# Enderman Look

**Category:** World  
**Aliases:** Enderman Look

## What it does

Either looks at all Endermen or prevents you from looking at Endermen.

Description basis: [publisher description](https://github.com/MeteorDevelopment/meteor-client/blob/e3a2e77967629d216e127b5ceecf71fb15f9d2e5/src/main/java/meteordevelopment/meteorclient/systems/modules/world/EndermanLook.java). The module's behavior on a stock Minecraft 26.3 server has not been verified unless separately documented in [research](../../RESEARCH.md).
